2027 ODI World Cup May Open on Gandhi Jayanti

The International Cricket Council (ICC) is reportedly considering opening the 2027 ODI World Cup on October 2, Gandhi Jayanti. The tournament is expected to feature 14 teams and last for 50 days. This potential opening date is seen as a tribute to Mahatma Gandhi. The event is scheduled to be held in India and Bangladesh.
